The commits list in `/desk-diff` now shows times that match its order.

- Each commit showed its author date, which rebase and cherry-pick keep, so a rebased commit at the top could read "74 minutes ago" above one from "2 minutes ago". The row now shows the commit date, the same date the list is ordered by
- When the author date is 10 minutes or more away from the commit date, the row adds it in parentheses: `16 minutes ago (authored 2 hours ago)`

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-asana@cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-slack@cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
